title: Alert Assembly Studio and Incident Anchor Panel
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a composable Alert Assembly Studio (a canvas for constructing alert rules, SLO attachments, and rollout targets) paired with an Incident Anchor Panel that surfaces runbooks, postmortem links, and a cost/latency impact preview. The goal is to let engineers and on-call responders assemble alerts with contextual previews, then hand off incidents in one click while preserving traceable links to postmortems and cost signals.
goals: Enable fast, error-resistant alert creation with preflight previews of SLO/SLI impacts
Surface postmortem and runbook links in-context so responders always have playbooks available
Provide a lightweight on-call handoff flow that captures state, links, and a quick responder relay
Surface estimated token-cost and latency delta for new alerts to prevent alert-driven budget regressions
decisions: Use progressive disclosure: keep advanced SLO tuning collapsed behind 'Advanced' to avoid cognitive overload
Anchor panel will include a curated subset of runbook links and a single canonical postmortem link (instead of multiple free-form links) to reduce ambiguous references
Cost preview will use a sampled token distribution and be labeled as an estimate, not a hard SLA
tradeoffs: Showing cost and latency estimates increases upfront complexity in the setup UI but reduces downstream budget surprises
Tight coupling to runbook links makes the panel more actionable but requires stricter naming conventions in docs
One-click handoff captures snapshot metadata but could surface sensitive fields; those are redacted behind role checks
reviewer_feedback: PM (Katherine Liu): prefer clearer microcopy for 'Estimate' vs 'Projected' — we chose 'Estimated impact'
Eng (Derek O'Neal): asked that KV-cache and rollout binding be visible for Dedicated customers — added a small badge in the studio
SRE (Priyanka Rao): requested a rapid 'revoke handoff' action if wrong responder chosen — added reversible transfer state for 60s
usability_notes: Moderated usability test (n=8) showed 2 patterns: builders who wanted templates and responders who wanted single-click context capture
Participants mis-clicked on 'Attach SLO' often; moved to larger touch target and introduced inline helper text
Color contrast adjustments made for badge states to meet AA accessibility
next_steps: Finalize content for advanced SLO modal and microcopy review by PM (due 2026-03-16)
Hand off design tokens and interaction spec to frontend (backend feature flagging required)
Create GH issue for telemetry instrumentation: alert_preflight_preview_shown and handoff_confirmed events
Prototype A/B test: canvas-with-templates vs. blank-canvas to measure setup time and error rate
